title: AAPS Release_3.4.2.1 Omnipod Dash didn't set the Profile
symptom: After switching from Virtual MDI profile to Omnipod Dash, the main screen shows 'Profile Not Set' and the user is unable to change the profile. The issue occurs after a clean install of AAPS 3.4.2.1 with imported settings, and also after switching xDrip source to BYOD. Another user reports the same problem during a version upgrade on Dash pod, making the app unusable.
cause: The thread suggests incompatibility with legacy settings, as deleting the AAPS directory fixed the issue. The exact root cause is not explicitly identified.
fix: Delete the AAPS directory (after backing up profiles) using the files app on the phone. After deletion, the profile finally sets. Then deactivate the pod, exit early, and hit discard when prompted. Recreate/reset the AAPS directory after that to avoid later issues.
evidence_quote: Deleting my aaps directory fixed this for me. But there's definitely some incompatability with legacy settings here and the answer was non obvious. the tell is that when you do that, the profile finally sets.
